PRAYER : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In  praying for issuance of Writ of declaration, declaring the impugned  acquisition proceedings issued under Section 3(A) Gazette Notificat  has been published on behalf of the Government of India vide S.O.No  1195(E) dated 17.03.2018 for acquisition of lands for widening of N  209, published in Local News Papers namely, The Daily Thanthi (Tami  dated 22.03.2018, as illegal and unconstitutional and consequently   the respondents issue fresh notification by following provisions  contemplated under the National Highways Act, 1956 and Right to Fai  Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation a  Resettlement Act, 2013.
 For Petitioner :Mr. Al.Kannan
For Respondents :Mr.D.Sadiq Raja  Addl.
Government Pleader for R3 to R5
Mr.G.Raja Raman  CGSC for R1 & R2
ORDER The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submitted that the relief sought for in the writ petition has become infructuous and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.
